lifecycle: qualify a disclosed native positive control using the same ordinary edge annotation and software-stop mechanism before any candidate route claim
in fresh owned process open exact linked drawing/child and verify file/config identity, original 16-row drawing/19-row child tree where applicable, analytic solid geometry and view transform

enumerate actual component/view edges; select one exact line through independent endpoint predicate, create one note, attach to that edge and require boolean success, one nonnull attached entity, exact expected type, not dangling and exact geometry
edit only the note text and its explicitly chosen position, then arm all required stops before SaveAs; do not wait until event7; record operation start/return and normal events7/9/28 separately
save with0errors0warnings; remove stops, verify dynamic original bytes restored and debugger absence; COM owns close
fresh process opens saved drawing, verifies the same actual child/configuration and note text/position plus one nonnull actual edge attachment, geometry and non-dangling state

independently change the existing linked child boss depth driver, rebuild/update the drawing and verify body mass/volume/area response plus continued edge attachment against independent analytic endpoints; the chosen Front rail remains geometrically fixed when only depth changes, so do not claim a changed projected length; save synchronized child/drawing and fresh reopen
final known control must repeat its own edit/save/reopen with healthy license inventory and distinct process identities; do not count post-constructor controls as pre-writer heldouts
